proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3167 *kiyatta gives Gawri kata, Palula katī, Hindi kittā, and explicit -n and -r extensions kitnā/kitrā. These simple quantity-question forms fit those attested extensions; unexplained loss of t or added aspiration is left for local review. Reviewed comparison: Goj kitne “how many?” (f_tpa5ehez2pd26). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.

Forms without s need separate comparison with other interrogative bases. Reviewed comparison: hadothi_kelwada kesɔ “what kind?” (f_umpirk3bylz34).
